parameters.name: DagId
parameters.description: The task flow ID. You can call the [ListTaskFlow](~~424565~~) or [ListLhTaskFlowAndScenario](~~426672~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: Edges
parameters.description: The list of task flow edges.

sub_parameters.name: NodeEnd
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the end node of the edge.

sub_parameters.name: NodeFrom
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the start node of the edge.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The tenant ID.
> You can move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console and view the tenant ID. For more information, see [View tenant information](~~181330~~).
